analysis.name: V3 Gate-1 reconstruction of corrected-calendar rebuilt-treatment pooled baseline
analysis.status: post-outcome referee-led diagnostic; checkpoint reproduction, not a confirmatory result

missing_handling.rule: retain as genuinely absent; do not interpolate or compress elapsed calendar time

transition_handling.dynamic_models: retain 2022-12 under separately identified dynamic specifications

microdata_eligibility.occupation: valid observed OCC routed to Census 2018; strict exposure and Webb support applied at occupation-contract stage
microdata_eligibility.weight: finite WTFINL strictly greater than zero

sources.access_class: licensed restricted CPS microdata; read-only SCC input
sources.vintage: IPUMS CPS extract 9, January 2017 through July 2026

sources.access_class: licensed restricted CPS microdata; read-only SCC input
restricted derived CPS aggregate; read-only SCC input
sources.vintage: authenticated January 2017 through November 2022 preperiod occupation-month cells used by the historical-treatment diagnostic checkpoints
frozen YAX coverage-sensitivity values; authenticated but not used in Rule-A baseline

sources.access_class: restricted provenance; excluded from sanitized public package

dependencies.role: reference rebuilt fixed-membership vector for checkpoint comparison

boundary_handling.eta: sigmoid implementation protects overflow; fitted probability clipped to [1e-10, 1-1e-10]
boundary_handling.initialization: occupation shares initialized with (young+0.5)/(total+1.0), then clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6]
boundary_handling.step: each Newton coordinate step clipped to [-1,1]
boundary_handling.zero_total_cells: excluded from objective and score; returned placeholders are not estimates

estimator.identifying_normalizations: month fixed effect for first observed month anchored at zero after every nuisance update; absorbed treatment target is invariant to the compensating occupation shift
nuisance_column_space: Webb software-exposure z-score interacted with post
estimator.objective: frequency-weighted grouped-binomial log likelihood for young stock conditional on young-plus-older employed stock; conditional equivalent of the two-age PPML for the age-share contrast
estimator.separation_treatment: no penalty, pseudocount in the fitted objective, selective deletion, or explicit separation correction; inherited numerical clipping is fully declared and audited in N01-N03

solver.algorithm: alternating nuisance Newton updates plus weighted-absorbed Newton update for target coefficients

exposure.construction_age_universe: ages 22 through 65, young plus older employed stock

construction_weights.definition: sum of rebuilt young and older employment stock over the 71-month preperiod

exposure.raw_scale: Eloundou dv_rating_beta share on [0,1], defined by the source as E1 plus one-half E2
exposure.tie_rule: left: values equal to a cut remain in the lower quintile

training_dates.status: not present in the vendored occupation CSV as a separate analysis parameter
training_dates.treatment_provenance: source field dv_rating_beta is labeled GPT-4-model-rated in the frozen lookup documentation; no training cutoff is imputed

version.coverage_rule: Rule A: full target-route exposure coverage required; surviving partial routes are never renormalized

webb_normalization.weights: same fixed 71-month preperiod young-plus-older occupation weights

analysis_subset.rule: canonical universe; no outcome-ranked or family-specific deletion

crosswalk.allocation_rule: 2017-2019 raw Census-2010 OCC is fractionally routed to Census 2018 with fixed bridge_weight; 2020 onward raw Census-2018 OCC is direct; route mass is checked and not renormalized after exposure missingness
crosswalk.version: Census occupation 2010-to-2018 official conversion-rate bridge frozen by YAX

subgroup_eligibility.rule: none in the pooled baseline; family and other subgroup models require distinct specifications

universe.rule: positive rebuilt preperiod employment stock in both age groups, finite strict Rule-A beta, and finite Webb software exposure

outcome.cell_construction: sum WTFINL into occupation-by-calendar-month-by-age-group employment-stock cells after declared routing; absent eligible cells enter as zero stock
outcome.units: weighted CPS employed-person stock; likelihood outcome is young stock with grouped total young plus older stock

target.contrast: coefficient on Q5-by-post relative to omitted Q1-by-post in the joint Q2-Q5 profile, conditional on occupation FE, month FE, and Webb-software-z-by-post
target.temporal_weights: grouped-binomial likelihood implied over the 113 included observed months; no equal-month post averaging is substituted

uncertainty.source: occupation-cluster sandwich plus occupation-level wild-score multiplier bootstrap; finite-cluster correction G/(G-1)
